text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), a race she ran alongside 
everyone's dreams, Ines Fujin was smiling, 
having enjoyed the race from the bottom of 
her heart.

Ines Fujin will hesitate no longer. From 
now on, she will run joyfully for her own 
sake. And everyone's cheers will surely 
become her driving fuel.

For her next race, we decided to choose 
one where Ines Fujin could have the most 
fun.

The Japan Cup brings together Umamusume 
from all over the world. Even in a race 
like this, she is sure to enjoy it more 
than anyone else in the world!
